 "content": "from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 0 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells); r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells); c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            layers = []
            top, bottom, left, right = r0, r1, c0, c1
            while top <= bottom and left <= right:
                edge = set()
                for x in range(left, right + 1):
                    edge.add(grid[top][x]); edge.add(grid[bottom][x])
                for y in range(top, bottom + 1):
                    edge.add(grid[y][left]); edge.add(grid[y][right])
                if len(edge) != 1 or 0 in edge:
                    break
                color = next(iter(edge))
                if not layers or layers[-1] != color:
                    layers.append(color)
                top += 1; bottom -= 1; left += 1; right -= 1
            if layers:
                mapping = {old: new for old, new in zip(layers, reversed(layers))}
                for y, x in cells:
                    out[y][x] = mapping.get(grid[y][x], grid[y][x])
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
